_comment: M-ARC Task A3: the Relc join/veto beat, run by the deep_tunnels `awakened_boss` encounter's `conversation` (interact.encounter branch fires it before combat). Relc (canon: Relc Grasstongue, Senior Guardsman, [Spearmaster] -- wiki.wanderinginn.com/Relc; loud, blunt, jokes about spears and gate-duty paperwork, secretly reliable) is the context+veto party: [Go together.] banks `relc_joined_descent`, which satisfies the awakened_boss entity's `ally_requires` so Relc fields as a combat ally; [I go alone.] routes through a confirm-shaped 'you sure?' guard and banks `went_alone` (NEVER relc_joined_descent), so the boss fields no ally -- the honest, measured 0.04 solo cell (the player chose it). BOTH branches end on a `start_combat: awakened_boss` effect (self-reference; legal only on an ending option). The opening node folds the draft's pre-boss environmental beat ('Bones. Old fires...') into Relc's voice (a wiring-demanded minimal adaptation -- the encounter branch has no on-approach toast hook, and it reads honest as Relc reading the room). The draft's bracketed '[Warrior]' address is dropped: the PC's class is variable (Mage/Diplomat/etc.), so a hardcoded class would contradict a non-Warrior PC (opacity + canon-consistency). Copy is Fable-drafted, USER TASTE-GATED before ship (see docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-06-m-arc-climax-copy-draft.md). Voice-lint clean: no banned tells; specific spear/teeth humor; reads aloud in Relc's register. No `requires`/`hide_when` on any option (no progress leak), so the softlock guard is trivially satisfied (every option always visible).

join.speaker: Relc
join.text: Bones. Old fires. Something's been living down here a good long while — and it just heard us walk in. ...Deep tunnels, huh? You know what lives in deep tunnels? Me. As of today. Come on — you swing, I'll skewer.

alone_confirm.speaker: Relc
alone_confirm.text: Alone? Ha! You're either very brave or very— actually, no. Just the one thing. I'll hang back at the mouth, then, and let the professional wait by the door for once. Shout if you find teeth. ...You sure about this?
